tenderLanguage: Acoustic doors and glazing shall be supplied with declared STC/OITC performance data for the proposed configuration.
Movable partitions shall include perimeter compression seals, acoustic sweep seals, and a documented stacking or parking arrangement.
Submittals shall include shop drawings, hardware schedules, seal details, and installation methodology for consultant approval.
approvalChecklist: Room-by-room acoustic target or consultant brief.
Opening schedule with wall thickness, finished floor levels, and ceiling coordination.
Operation requirements for student use, auditorium teams, maintenance access, and emergency egress.

tenderLanguage: Acoustic assemblies shall be engineered for the stated plant noise profile, including low-frequency equipment noise where applicable.
Door and frame sets shall include heavy-duty hardware, perimeter seals, threshold sealing, and finish schedules suited to industrial traffic.
Automation packages shall define motor duty cycle, safety devices, manual release, control interface, and PLC/BMS integration points.
approvalChecklist: Source noise level, octave-band data when available, and target room-side noise criteria.
Opening sizes, wall build-up, equipment access clearances, and fire or egress constraints.
Control philosophy for barriers, gates, shutters, safety loops, sensors, and access-control integration.
